review_scope: Independent source checks of three central claims per completed report, plus targeted provenance and phase-cell checks. Not an exhaustive literature review or complete second rubric audit.

checks.claim: The presentation reports 28 DMP documents and 556 selected expert judgments; the displayed validation workflow exposes the AI judgment.
checks.primary_locator: Repo presentation physical p16; rendered and visually inspected independently.
checks.boundary: Judgments are nested and selected. No inference of 556 plans, full-corpus accuracy or an independent blinded reference.

checks.claim: Consistency and expert agreement are different measurements; explicit checks show 94% consistency and 56% expert agreement.
checks.primary_locator: Repo presentation physical p17; independently read extracted text and rendered table.
checks.boundary: Category denominators and repeated-run design are not reconstructed from the displayed percentages.

checks.claim: The exact presentation/API capture is verifiable, while the thesis access response is not a thesis PDF or evidence that its methods are absent.
checks.primary_locator: repo-record.json metadata.license and files; local PDF MD5/SHA-256; uhasselt-access-response.html/.json.
checks.boundary: API PDF checksum matches local MD5. API metadata.license.id is cc-by-4.0. Thesis HTTP503 notice explicitly restricts access; thesis methods and cached-summary claims were not independently verified here.

checks.claim: 4a end has changed acceptance routes: the publication includes controlled-access and documented exception routes omitted by the native anonymized-output wording.
checks.primary_locator: Publication physical p14, printed p13, end-project column; native /data_management_plan/3/subsections/0/stages/end_project.
checks.boundary: Comparison of instrument wording; not legal advice or a judgment about any project.

checks.claim: 5a early changes two conditional publication checks into alternatives joined by OR in native wording.
checks.primary_locator: Publication physical p18, printed p17, 5a early column; native /data_management_plan/4/subsections/0/stages/proposal_early_stage.
checks.boundary: This identifies changed acceptance logic; no numeric conversion or phase policy is approved.

checks.claim: 5b early loses the publication retention-period example and funder/community qualifier in native wording.
checks.primary_locator: Publication physical p19, printed p18, 5b early continuation; native /data_management_plan/4/subsections/1/stages/proposal_early_stage.
checks.boundary: The report correctly asks for calibration rather than declaring a universal ten-year obligation.

checks.claim: Pham compares automated text-mining analysis with manual 16-criterion 0/1/2 scoring of 21 Belmont Forum DMPs, with discussion to consensus.
checks.primary_locator: Captured primary HTML sections4,4.1,4.2, independently read.
checks.boundary: Text-mining coverage and reconciled ratings do not validate LLM criterion sufficiency or independent inter-rater agreement.

checks.claim: Sharma is a 2023 chapter applying two human instruments to 150 plans across award years; once per instrument is not full independent double coding.
checks.primary_locator: PDF physical p1/printed26 and physical pp8-9/printed33-34; independently extracted and read.
checks.boundary: The inspected longitudinal sample does not establish repeated same-project DMP version pairs.

checks.claim: Miksa maps six maDMP assessment methods to four reviewer goals; narrative non-ambiguity is outside the implemented coverage.
checks.primary_locator: PDF physical p9, Table1 and adjacent discussion; independently rendered, visually inspected and text-read.
checks.boundary: A method/goal mapping is not a human-versus-LLM accuracy benchmark.

additional_checks.claim: Publication5d mid-project cell is visually blank.
additional_checks.boundary: Instrument undefined differs from native absence and document-level NA.

additional_checks.claim: Framework phases are qualitative, with no numeric duration cutoffs in section3.
additional_checks.boundary: Sampling <=50% and >100% does not automatically choose rubric phases.

additional_checks.claim: Frnka/Suchanek Crossref capture supplies 2026 publication dates.
additional_checks.boundary: Metadata dates do not verify article methods. Full text remains uninspected.

remaining_dependencies: Vandenberk thesis methods unavailable at normally accessed institutional server; cached summary is not full methods verification.
Frnka2025 thesis and Frnka/Suchanek2026 article methods remain uninspected; incomplete retrieval cannot establish design absence.
Phase policy, phase-specific anchors, numeric scale comparison and primary estimand remain unapproved methods decisions.
Human pilot remains deferred; independent reference assessments and experiment freeze remain pending.
limits: Checked claims are suitable for bounded planning records, not empirical performance or global novelty claims. I did not independently verify all rubric cells, all presentation screenshot metrics, cached thesis summary text, search completeness, or inaccessible methods.
